            <script id="medallia-nav-assign">
            (function () {
                var CONFIG = {"force":"a","variants":["a","b","c"],"weights":[100,0,0],"cookie":"medallia_nav_variant","days":30,"fallback":"a"};
                // Two lists, not one: the two TrustArc cookies index their
                // categories differently. See medallia_header_consent_categories().
                var CATEGORIES = {"cmapi":[2,3],"prefs":[1,2]};
                // See medallia_header_assume_consent() — never true on production.
                var ASSUME_CONSENT = false;
                var root = document.documentElement;

                function setSource(v, source) {
                    root.setAttribute('data-hdr', v);
                    // Lets Adobe separate a real assignment from a fallback and
                    // exclude the fallbacks from the activity's numbers.
                    root.setAttribute('data-hdr-source', source);
                }

                function readCookie(name) {
                    var m = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(?:^|; )' + name + '=([^;]*)'));
                    return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
                }

                function valid(v) { return CONFIG.variants.indexOf(v) !== -1; }

                /**
                 * Consent, read straight from TrustArc's cookies.
                 *
                 * Deliberately NOT window.PrivacyManagerAPI: that arrives with
                 * TrustArc's async script, and depending on it here would trade
                 * Adobe's race for an identical one.
                 *
                 * Fails closed. Anything unrecognised, malformed or absent counts
                 * as "no consent", which means no cookie and the control.
                 */
                /**
                 * True when the permitted list contains any category we accept.
                 *
                 * The accepted list is a parameter rather than a closed-over
                 * constant so that the caller has to say WHICH numbering it is
                 * passing — sharing one list across both formats is the defect
                 * this replaced.
                 */
                function allows(permitted, accepted) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < accepted.length; i++) {
                        if (permitted.indexOf(String(accepted[i])) !== -1) return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                }

                function hasConsent() {
                    if (ASSUME_CONSENT) return true;

                    // `cmapi_cookie_privacy` looks like "permit 1,2,3", or
                    // "permit 1 required" when only required was granted. 1-indexed.
                    var cmapi = readCookie('cmapi_cookie_privacy');
                    if (cmapi) {
                        return allows(cmapi.replace(/[^0-9,]/g, '').split(','), CATEGORIES.cmapi);
                    }

                    // `notice_gdpr_prefs` looks like "0,1,2:" — a category list. 0-indexed.
                    var prefs = readCookie('notice_gdpr_prefs');
                    if (prefs !== null) {
                        return allows(prefs.split(':')[0].split(','), CATEGORIES.prefs);
                    }

                    return false;
                }

                /**
                 * Deliberately conservative: matching a crawler wrongly only means
                 * that visitor sees the control and is left out of the test, which is
                 * far cheaper than letting crawlers get bucketed.
                 */
                function isBot() {
                    return /bot|crawl|spider|slurp|bingpreview|headless|lighthouse|pagespeed|preview|monitor/i
                        .test(navigator.userAgent || '');
                }

                function writeCookie(v) {
                    document.cookie = CONFIG.cookie + '=' + encodeURIComponent(v)
                        + '; path=/; max-age=' + (CONFIG.days * 86400)
                        + '; SameSite=Lax'
                        + (location.protocol === 'https:' ? '; Secure' : '');
                }

                /** Cumulative-weight draw. Weight 0 is never newly assigned. */
                function pick() {
                    var total = 0, i;
                    for (i = 0; i < CONFIG.weights.length; i++) total += CONFIG.weights[i];
                    if (total <= 0) return null;

                    var r = Math.random() * total, acc = 0;
                    for (i = 0; i < CONFIG.weights.length; i++) {
                        acc += CONFIG.weights[i];
                        if (r < acc) return CONFIG.variants[i];
                    }
                    return CONFIG.variants[CONFIG.variants.length - 1];
                }

                // 1. QA override. Already applied server-side; never writes a cookie,
                //    so reviewing a variant cannot pollute a real assignment.
                var pre = root.getAttribute('data-hdr');
                if (valid(pre)) { setSource(pre, 'hv'); return; }

                /**
                 * 2. Kill switch. ABOVE the cookie read on purpose — forcing has to
                 *    beat an existing assignment or it is not a kill switch. Changing
                 *    the weights alone would leave everyone already assigned on their
                 *    variant for the full 30 days.
                 *
                 *    Writes nothing, so flipping it back returns people to whatever
                 *    they were already assigned rather than reshuffling them.
                 */
                if (valid(CONFIG.force)) { setSource(CONFIG.force, 'force'); return; }

                // 3. Already assigned on an earlier pageview.
                var existing = readCookie(CONFIG.cookie);
                if (valid(existing)) { setSource(existing, 'cookie'); return; }

                /**
                 * 4. Crawlers render the control and are never bucketed. Keeps bots
                 *    out of the split and stops them fragmenting the reporting.
                 */
                if (isBot()) { setSource(CONFIG.fallback, 'bot'); return; }

                /**
                 * 5. No functional consent — control, and write nothing.
                 *
                 *    This is stable rather than sticky: with no cookie the gate simply
                 *    denies again on every pageview, so the visitor gets the control
                 *    every time. Adobe can still see what they were shown by reading
                 *    data-hdr-active / data-hdr-source, which are DOM attributes and
                 *    therefore not storage and not gated.
                 */
                if (!hasConsent()) { setSource(CONFIG.fallback, 'no-consent'); return; }

                // 6. Assign.
                var picked = pick();
                if (!picked) { setSource(CONFIG.fallback, 'force'); return; }
                writeCookie(picked);
                setSource(picked, 'assigned');
            })();
        </script>

        /**
         * All the header's own JS, in one idempotent function.
         *
         * Declared here but not run here: all three navs are still in the DOM at

         * would bind to variant A whichever variant is actually shown. The prune

         * Idempotent so a second call — a Target offer arriving late and calling
         * medalliaNav.apply() — cannot double-bind the scroll and mousemove
         * handlers.
         */
        window.initHeaderNav = (function () {
            var bound = false;

            return function () {
                if (bound) return;
                bound = true;

                var colorBar = document.querySelector(".background-color-bar");
                var subMenus = document.querySelectorAll(".sub-menu");

                /**
                 * Guarded. Pre-existing and unrelated to the test: this block used
                 * to dereference colorBar unconditionally, so a header without
                 * .background-color-bar threw during parse and killed every
                 * statement after it — including the locale demo-button rewrite.
                 */
                if (colorBar) {
                    document.addEventListener("scroll", (e) => {
                        if (window.scrollY !== 0) {
                            colorBar.classList.add("background-box-shadow");
                        } else {
                            colorBar.classList.remove("background-box-shadow");
                        }
                        for (let i = 0; i < subMenus.length; i++) {
                            const elStyles = getComputedStyle(subMenus[i]);
                            if (elStyles.top !== "-600px") {
                                colorBar.classList.remove("background-box-shadow");
                                break;
                            } else {
                                colorBar.classList.add("background-box-shadow");
                            }
                        }
                    });

                    /**
                     * Is any dropdown open? Same test the scroll handler above
                     * uses — a closed panel sits at top: -600px.
                     */
                    const anyPanelOpen = () => {
                        for (let i = 0; i < subMenus.length; i++) {
                            if (getComputedStyle(subMenus[i]).top !== "-600px") {
                                return true;
                            }
                        }
                        return false;
                    };

                    document.addEventListener("mousemove", () => {
                        if (window.scrollY !== 0) {
                            colorBar.classList.add("background-box-shadow");
                        } else {
                            colorBar.classList.remove("background-box-shadow");
                        }

                        /**
                         * Keyed off whether a panel is actually open, NOT off what
                         * happens to be under the cursor.
                         *
                         * This used to ask `e.target.closest(".menu-item")`, which
                         * flips every time the pointer crosses a gap between two
                         * labels — the target there is `.center-menu-items`, which is
                         * outside any `.menu-item`. Sweeping across the five
                         * top-level labels toggled this class 84 times in one pass,
                         * and the shadow visibly bounced on and off under the bar.
                         *
                         * Panel state is the thing the shadow actually cares about,
                         * it does not change as the pointer moves between labels, and
                         * it matches the scroll handler so the two cannot disagree.
                         */
                        if (anyPanelOpen()) {
                            colorBar.classList.remove("background-box-shadow");
                        } else {
                            colorBar.classList.add("background-box-shadow");
                        }
                    });
                }

                // Same guard, same reason: demoButtons[0] was dereferenced blind.
                var demoButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.demo-request');
                if (!demoButtons.length) return;

                var demoButtonRef = demoButtons[0].getAttribute('href');
                if (!demoButtonRef) return;

                const urlObj = new URL(demoButtonRef, window.location.origin);
                const origin = urlObj.origin;
                const path = urlObj.pathname;
                const search = urlObj.search;

                const locales = ["/fr/", "/it/", "/es/", "/de/", "/ja/", "/ko/", "/pt-br/"];
                for (let i = 0; i < locales.length; i++) {
                    if (!window.location.href.includes(locales[i])) continue;

                    const newPath = locales[i].slice(0, -1) + path;
                    demoButtons.forEach(element => {
                        element.setAttribute('href', `${origin}${newPath}${search}`)
                    });
                    break;
                }
            };
        })();

    <script>
        /**
         * Leave one nav in the DOM, then let the nav JS bind.
         *
         * Synchronous, during HTML parse: the nav is never hidden and never
         * arrives late. Adobe Launch is a blocking script in <head> (see the
         * 'adobe' handle in functions.php — no async, no defer), so a page-load
         * Target offer has already set `data-hdr` by the time this runs.
         *
         * An answer that lands after this point is inert rather than acted on:
         * `apply()` finds the prune settled and does nothing, so the visitor
         * keeps the nav they were served instead of watching it change. That is
         * the deliberate trade-off — a late activity collects no data, but no
         * visitor ever sees the wrong nav or waits for the right one.
         */
        (function () {
            var VARIANTS = ["a","b","c"];
            var DEFAULT = "a";
            /**
             * QA-only. When the on-page switcher is drawn we keep every variant in
             * the DOM so it can toggle between them live and you can see that the
             * chrome never repaints. Gated by the same constant as the switcher, so
             * it is false everywhere the switcher is absent — including production.
             */
            var QA_KEEP_ALL = false;
            var root = document.documentElement;
            var settled = false;

            function valid(v) { return VARIANTS.indexOf(v) !== -1; }

            /** Publish the decision and let the nav JS bind. */
            function finish(active) {
                root.setAttribute('data-hdr', active);
                // Read by the Adobe Analytics client to attribute the test.
                root.setAttribute('data-hdr-active', active);

                if (typeof window.initHeaderNav === 'function') window.initHeaderNav();

                /**
                 * `variant` is set before the event so late listeners can tell
                 * "already done" from "not yet". main.js is enqueued in the footer
                 * and therefore always misses the event itself.
                 */
                window.medalliaNav.variant = active;
                document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('medallia:nav-ready', {
                    detail: { variant: active }
                }));
            }

            function prune(active) {
                if (settled) return;
                settled = true;

                if (QA_KEEP_ALL) { finish(active); return; }

                /**
                 * Only menu items carry data-nav-variant, so this can never touch
                 * the shared chrome. CSS has already hidden the losers; removing
                 * them keeps document.querySelector-based nav JS unambiguous.
                 */
                var list = document.querySelectorAll('#site-header [data-nav-variant]');
                for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                    if (list[i].getAttribute('data-nav-variant') !== active) {
                        list[i].parentNode.removeChild(list[i]);
                    }
                }

                finish(active);
            }

            window.medalliaNav = {
                variant: null,
                apply: function (v) { if (valid(v)) prune(v); }
            };

            // `?hv=` sets this server-side; a Target offer in the blocking <head>
            // embed sets it before the body is parsed.
            var pre = root.getAttribute('data-hdr');
            if (valid(pre)) { prune(pre); return; }

            /**
             * Carried forward from an earlier pageview. Read client-side, never in
             * PHP: WP Engine does not vary its page-cache key on arbitrary cookies,
             * so server-side personalisation here would serve the first anonymous
             * visitor's variant to everyone.
             */
            var m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )medallia_nav_variant=([^;]*)/);
            if (m && valid(m[1])) { prune(m[1]); return; }

            prune(DEFAULT);
        })();

        searchInput.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
            clearTimeout(typingTimer);
            const query = e.target.value.trim();

            if (query.length < 2) {
                resultsBox.style.display = 'none';
                filtersBox.style.display = 'none';
                resultsBox.innerHTML = '';
                currentData = null;
                return;
            }

            typingTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                resultsBox.style.display = 'block';
                resultsBox.innerHTML = '<p style="color: #888;">Loading...</p>';
                filtersBox.style.display = 'none';

                fetch(`/wp-json/custom-search/v1/search?s=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`)
                    .then(res => res.ok ? res.json() : Promise.reject('Network error'))
                    .then(data => {
                        if (data.code && data.message) throw new Error(data.message);
                        
                        currentData = data; 
                        activeFilter = 'All'; 
                        
                        renderFilters();
                        renderResults(query);
                    })
                    .catch(err => {
                        resultsBox.innerHTML = `<p style="color: #fff;">No Results, please try a new search.</p>`;
                        trackSearch(query, false);
                    });
            }, 300);
        });
    }

    // --- Build Filter Buttons ---
    function renderFilters() {
        filtersBox.innerHTML = '';
        
        let availableCategories = [];
        for (const category in currentData) {
            if (currentData[category].length > 0) {
                availableCategories.push(category);
            }
        }

        if (availableCategories.length === 0) {
            filtersBox.style.display = 'none';
            return;
        }

        filtersBox.style.display = 'flex';
        filtersBox.appendChild(createFilterBtn('All'));

        availableCategories.forEach(cat => {
            filtersBox.appendChild(createFilterBtn(cat));
        });
    }

    // --- Create Individual Button element ---
    function createFilterBtn(label) {
        const isActive = activeFilter === label;
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.textContent = label;
        
        btn.style.padding = '8px 16px';
        btn.style.borderRadius = '30px';
        btn.style.border = `1px solid ${isActive ? '#C8FF00' : '#444'}`;
        btn.style.background = isActive ? '#C8FF00' : 'transparent';
        btn.style.color = isActive ? '#000' : '#fff';
        btn.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        btn.style.fontSize = '0.9rem';
        btn.style.fontWeight = isActive ? '600' : '400';
        btn.style.transition = 'all 0.2s ease';

        btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            activeFilter = label;
            renderFilters(); 
            renderResults(searchInput.value.trim()); 
        });

        return btn;
    }

    // --- Render the Results based on Filter ---
    function renderResults(query) {
        let html = '';
        let hasItems = false;

        for (const category in currentData) {
            if (currentData[category].length > 0 && (activeFilter === 'All' || activeFilter === category)) {
                hasItems = true;
                html += `
                    <div class="type-group" style="margin-bottom: 25px;">
                        <div class="type">
                            <p style="color: #C8FF00; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 1px;">${category}</p>
                        </div>
                `;
                currentData[category].forEach(item => {
                    html += `
                        <div class="item" style="margin-bottom: 15px;">
                            <a href="${item.url}" style="color: #fff; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; display: block; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.4;">
                                ${item.title}
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    `;
                });
                html += `</div>`;
            }
        }

        if (!hasItems) {
            html = `<p style="color: #fff;">No Results, please try a new search.</p>`;
            if (activeFilter === 'All') trackSearch(query, false); 
        } else {
            if (activeFilter === 'All') trackSearch(query, true);
        }

        resultsBox.innerHTML = html;
        resultsBox.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // --- Adobe Analytics Helper ---
    function trackSearch(term, isSuccess) {
        if (!window.adobeDataLayer) return;
        const searchData = {
            "siteKnowledge": {
                "supportSiteSearch": {
                    "instances": { "value": 1 },
                    "term": term
                }
            }
        };
        if (!isSuccess) {
            searchData.siteKnowledge.supportSiteSearch.nullInstances = { "value": 1 };
        }
        window.adobeDataLayer.push(searchData);
    }

    // Prevent double-splitting
    if (el.dataset.wordSplit === "1") return;

        function walk(node) {
            // TEXT NODE → split into words
            if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
            const text = node.textContent;
            if (!text.trim()) return;

            const words = text.split(/(\s+)/); // keep spaces
            const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

            words.forEach(word => {
                if (word.trim() === "") {
                frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(word));
                } else {

                span.className = "js-word";
                span.textContent = word;
                frag.appendChild(span);
                }
            });

            node.replaceWith(frag);
            }

            // ELEMENT NODE → recurse into children
            else if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
            // Skip elements we never want to touch
            if (node.tagName === "BR") return;

            [...node.childNodes].forEach(child => walk(child));
            }
        }

        walk(el);
        el.dataset.wordSplit = "1";
    }

  const mountHtml5 = (player, url) => {
    if (!url) return;

    video.autoplay = true;
    video.src = url;

    // Explicit play is more reliable than autoplay alone
    video.play().catch(() => {});
  };

  const mountVidyard = (player, uuid) => {
    if (!uuid) return;

    const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.allow = "autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture";

  const mount = (player, type, url, uuid) => {

    const type =

      player.getAttribute("data-video-type") ||

      player.getAttribute("data-video-url") ||
      "";

    if (player && !pauseVidyard(player)) clearPlayer(player);

    modal.setAttribute("data-state", "closed");

  document.querySelectorAll(modalSel).forEach((modal) => {

  if (!bar || !sentinel) return;

  const LARGE_BREAKPOINT = 992;

  // Responsive offset helper
  const getNavOffset = () => {
    return window.innerWidth >= LARGE_BREAKPOINT ? 80 : 60;
  };

  let NAV_OFFSET = getNavOffset();

  // Measure bar height once (and on resize)
  const setHeightVar = () => {
    const h = bar.offsetHeight || 0;
    root.style.setProperty("--nav-on-page-height", `${h}px`);
  };

  setHeightVar();

  // Capture the element’s original document position
  const initialTop =
    root.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset;

  let observer;

  const createObserver = () => {
    // Disconnect existing observer before recreating
    if (observer) observer.disconnect();

    NAV_OFFSET = getNavOffset();

    observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        const scrolledPast =
          window.pageYOffset > initialTop - NAV_OFFSET;

        root.classList.toggle("is-fixed", shouldFix);
      },
      {
        root: null,
        rootMargin: `-${NAV_OFFSET}px 0px 0px 0px`,
        threshold: 0,
      }
    );

    observer.observe(sentinel);
  };

  createObserver();

  // Recalculate everything on resize (orientation changes included)
  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    setHeightVar();
    createObserver();
  });
})

/* This template part prints this script once per include, so a page with two accordion
   instances used to get two copies — and each copy binds its own delegated click listener to
   `document`. One click then ran the toggle twice: the first opened the item, the second read
   the now-true aria-expanded, concluded it was open, and closed it again. Net effect on any
   page with an even number of instances: clicking an accordion did nothing.

   Initialising once is enough because the loop below is document-wide (it queries every
   `.accordions` on the page), and the click handler is delegated to `document`. */
if (!window.__medalliaAccordionsInit) {
  window.__medalliaAccordionsInit = true;

  const SELECTORS = {
    container: ".accordions",
    item: "[data-accordion-item]",
    trigger: ".accordion-item__trigger",
    panel: ".accordion-item__panel",
    mediaPanel: ".accordions-advanced__media-panel",
  };

  const setItemState = (item, isOpen) => {
    const trigger = item.querySelector(SELECTORS.trigger);
    const panel = item.querySelector(SELECTORS.panel);

    if (trigger) trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(isOpen));
    if (panel) panel.hidden = !isOpen;

    item.setAttribute("data-state", isOpen ? "open" : "closed");
  };

  const closeOtherItemsInContainer = (container, currentItem) => {
    container.querySelectorAll(SELECTORS.item).forEach((other) => {
      if (other === currentItem) return;
      setItemState(other, false);
    });
  };

  const setMediaStateByIndex = (root, idx) => {
    const panels = root.querySelectorAll(SELECTORS.mediaPanel);

    panels.forEach((p) => {
      p.hidden = true;
      p.setAttribute("data-state", "inactive");
    });

    const active = root.querySelector(
      `${SELECTORS.mediaPanel}[data-accordion-index="${CSS.escape(idx)}"]`
    );

    if (active) {
      active.hidden = false;
      active.setAttribute("data-state", "active");

    const firstItem = container.querySelector(SELECTORS.item);
    if (!firstItem) return;

    const hasContent = !!firstItem.querySelector('.accordion-item__panel-inner .accordion-item__copy');
    if (hasContent) {
      setItemState(firstItem, true);

    const idx = firstItem.dataset.index;
    const accordionId = firstItem.dataset.accordionId;

    const mediaRoot = document.querySelector(
      `.accordions-advanced__media-wrap[data-accordion-id="${CSS.escape(accordionId)}"]`
    );

    if (mediaRoot) {
      setMediaStateByIndex(mediaRoot, idx);
    }

    const trigger = e.target.closest(SELECTORS.trigger);
    if (!trigger) return;

    const item = trigger.closest(SELECTORS.item);
    if (!item) return;

      const accordionId = item.dataset.accordionId;

      const mediaRoot = document.querySelector(
        `.accordions-advanced__media-wrap[data-accordion-id="${CSS.escape(accordionId)}"]`
      );

      if (mediaRoot) {
